purpose: Migration evidence. Each AOT cmdlet port records every intentional behavior or architecture difference from its PowerShell source.

variances.sourceFeature: Cmdlet/ProcessBaseCommand lifecycle and WriteObject/WriteError contract
variances.targetDecision: AotCmdletBase plus AotExecutionContext and IPipelineRecord

variances.sourceFeature: Name, Id, InputObject, IncludeUserName, Module, FileVersionInfo and parameter sets
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata drives the source contract, while the executable descriptor admits Name, Id, IncludeUserName, Module, and FileVersionInfo directly. InputObject is executable only as one static ProcessRecord handoff into one registered downstream adapter; direct text binding and general command-to-command binding are rejected.

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell WildcardPattern
variances.targetDecision: AOT adapter currently supports case-insensitive * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: System.Diagnostics.Process and PSObject extended type data
variances.targetDecision: Typed AOT process, module, and file-version records expose the command data without PSObject extended type data

variances.sourceFeature: Module, FileVersionInfo, IncludeUserName, pipeline InputObject
variances.targetDecision: Module, FileVersionInfo, and IncludeUserName use IProcessCatalog. InputObject has one reviewed source-level shape: Get-Process feeds one downstream Get-Process through ProcessRecord; arbitrary record types, multiple input stages, property-name binding, and direct InputObject binding remain deferred.

variances.sourceFeature: Process ownership enrichment through platform process APIs and PowerShell error records
variances.targetDecision: IncludeUserName uses a dedicated IProcessOwnerReader. The only current local reader invokes fixed absolute /bin/ps with a fixed argument list on macOS/Linux; other platforms emit CouldNotRetrieveUserName. It is not a general process-launch service.

variances.sourceFeature: localized ProcessResources and ErrorRecord categories
variances.targetDecision: stable error IDs and plain messages in AotExecutionContext

variances.sourceFeature: TimeSpan/DateTime objects formatted by the PowerShell formatting system
variances.targetDecision: typed UptimeRecord with cmdlet-declared default Value column

variances.sourceFeature: InternalTestHooks plus terminating ErrorRecord when stopwatch timing is unavailable
variances.targetDecision: production Stopwatch.IsHighResolution check and ScriptException; the internal test hook is not carried over

variances.sourceFeature: PSHost.CurrentUICulture
variances.targetDecision: injectable IHostCulture whose local implementation reads CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture

variances.sourceFeature: full CultureInfo object and PowerShell formatter
variances.targetDecision: typed CultureRecord exposes Name, DisplayName, EnglishName, and LCID

variances.sourceFeature: culture lookup beyond invariant culture
variances.targetDecision: InvariantGlobalization=false; use platform ICU/globalization data while retaining Native AOT

variances.sourceFeature: PSHost.CurrentCulture and CultureInfo static APIs in cmdlet body
variances.targetDecision: injectable IHostCulture and ICultureCatalog services

variances.sourceFeature: Name ValueFromPipeline binding
variances.targetDecision: direct Name arguments only until the generic typed pipeline binder exists

variances.sourceFeature: ErrorRecord/localized messages and full CultureInfo object
variances.targetDecision: stable ItemNotFoundException error ID and typed CultureRecord columns

variances.sourceFeature: Verbs.FilterByVerbsAndGroups reflects over verb constants and VerbDescriptions loads .resx values through ResourceManager
variances.targetDecision: PwshAotPortGenerator reads Verbs.cs and VerbDescriptionStrings.resx at build time and emits 100 immutable GeneratedVerbInfo entries

variances.sourceFeature: System.Management.Automation.VerbInfo object and PowerShell formatter
variances.targetDecision: typed VerbRecord exposes Verb, AliasPrefix, Group, and Description columns

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell WildcardPattern supports character classes, ranges, and escaping
variances.targetDecision: shared SimpleWildcard applies case-insensitive * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: Verb and Group have ValueFromPipeline and ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName
variances.targetDecision: direct arguments are implemented; generic cross-command pipeline binding remains deferred

variances.sourceFeature: TimeZoneInfo cache, local zone, system catalogue, and ID lookup in ProcessRecord
variances.targetDecision: injectable ITimeZoneCatalog wraps TimeZoneInfo.ClearCachedData, Local, GetSystemTimeZones, and FindSystemTimeZoneById

variances.sourceFeature: TimeZoneHelper uses PowerShell WildcardPattern over StandardName and DaylightName
variances.targetDecision: same two source fields and case-insensitive matching, using shared SimpleWildcard with * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: Name has ValueFromPipeline=true
variances.targetDecision: direct Name arguments are implemented; generic scalar/record pipeline binding is deferred

variances.sourceFeature: full TimeZoneInfo object plus PowerShell ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: typed TimeZoneRecord projects Id, names, UTC offset, and daylight-saving capability

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell host exposes operating-system time-zone identifiers
variances.targetDecision: delegate identifier availability to TimeZoneInfo; no hard-coded IANA/Windows mapping is claimed

variances.sourceFeature: CoreCommandBase delegates path resolution and child-item operations to live SessionState providers and dynamic parameters
variances.targetDecision: A distinct immutable IPhysicalChildItemCatalog captures the host discovery root at composition and serves only canonical direct OS paths, exact file/dir classification, and FileSystemProvider.Dir's directories-then-files/current-culture-case-insensitive immediate ordering

variances.sourceFeature: Path and LiteralPath support providers, PS drives, wildcard/literal semantics, aliases, pipeline input, filters, include/exclude, recursion/depth, force, and dynamic parameters
variances.targetDecision: Only generated Path is admitted as default positional or named direct input. LiteralPath/PSPath/LP and every other parameter remain outside the descriptor; provider-qualified paths, wildcard syntax, hidden entries, and symbolic-link traversal fail closed or are excluded

variances.sourceFeature: The provider emits FileSystemInfo/PSObject objects with provider-specific properties, ETS type data, and formatting
variances.targetDecision: PhysicalChildItemRecord is a closed adapter with upstream Unix display facts UnixMode/User/Group/LastWriteTime/Size/Name plus explicitly named direct-path structural fields (Path/FullName/ParentPath/Type/Kind/Length/IsDirectory/LastWriteTimeUtc), registered explicitly in PipelineValueAdapter

variances.sourceFeature: FileSystem_format_ps1xml childrenWithUnixStat dynamically selects a grouped Unix table through the PowerShell format/type system
variances.targetDecision: Compile the source-backed PSParentPath grouping and UnixMode/User/Group/LastWriteTime/Size/Name columns, headers, alignments, widths, and LastWriteTime format into one fixed AotTableLayout; apply it only to a direct untransformed Get-ChildItem result

variances.sourceFeature: CorePsPlatform.Unix obtains mode, uid, gid, and size through libpsl-native and TypeTable script properties resolve user/group names
variances.targetDecision: MacOsPhysicalMetadata uses a reviewed macOS-arm64 descriptor walk from /: each component is observed with fstatat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW) and acquired from its already-open parent with openat(O_NOFOLLOW), then final descriptor fstat supplies facts; getpwuid/getgrgid use an explicit uid/gid name cache. A final or ancestor link fails closed with AOT6205. Non-reviewed platforms/architectures fail closed with AOT6209 and other no-follow acquisition or metadata failures fail closed with AOT6210

variances.sourceFeature: Provider failures arrive as localized ErrorRecord variants and can have provider-specific category/target metadata
variances.targetDecision: The direct catalog emits source-spanned nonterminating AOT6201-AOT6208 diagnostics for provider syntax, wildcard use, invalid/not-found paths, hidden/link policy, access, and I/O boundaries

variances.sourceFeature: Both Get-ChildItem and Get-FileHash eventually use filesystem/provider paths but have independent source command contracts
variances.targetDecision: Do not widen IPhysicalFileResolver or alter Get-FileHash terminal-wildcard behavior. Child enumeration has a separately injected fixed capability so policy cannot leak across ports

variances.sourceFeature: GetItemCommand Path/LiteralPath/provider parameter declarations and parameter sets
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata remains authoritative; the active adapter admits only generated mandatory positional-or-named Path.

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord delegates Get-Item to InvokeProvider.Item.Get through SessionState and CmdletProviderContext
variances.targetDecision: Extend the existing immutable IPhysicalChildItemCatalog with GetDirectPhysicalItem, sharing captured-root canonicalization, provider/wildcard rejection, all-components no-follow acquisition, metadata, cancellation, and diagnostics while returning exactly one item rather than enumerating a directory.

variances.sourceFeature: FileSystemProvider returns FileInfo/DirectoryInfo objects enriched through PSObject/ETS
variances.targetDecision: Reuse the existing finite PhysicalChildItemRecord and explicit PipelineValueAdapter registration; no provider object, PSObject, reflection, or arbitrary property bag enters the pipeline.

variances.sourceFeature: Dynamic FileSystemInfo type-data and childrenWithUnixStat table selection
variances.targetDecision: Move the existing source-attributed Unix layout under PhysicalItemPresentation and reuse it by identity for Get-Item and Get-ChildItem; dynamic format/type discovery remains deferred.

variances.sourceFeature: The mandatory Path parameter can trigger PowerShell's interactive mandatory-parameter prompt when omitted.
variances.targetDecision: The noninteractive Native AOT static binder preserves generated mandatory Path metadata but does not implement an interactive prompt. An omitted Path therefore fails closed with source-spanned AOT6211 and a checked plain-terminal diagnostic snapshot; it never becomes an empty-result lookup. A future interactive-host contract is the required second-pass admission path; the cmdlet must not recreate prompting itself.

variances.sourceFeature: TestPathCommand Path/LiteralPath/PathType/provider parameter declarations and parameter sets
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata remains authoritative; the active adapter admits only generated mandatory positional-or-named Path and generated PathType/Type.

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord delegates existence and container checks to InvokeProvider.Item.Exists and IsContainer through SessionState and CmdletProviderContext
variances.targetDecision: Extend IPhysicalChildItemCatalog with ProbeDirectPhysicalItem, sharing captured-root canonicalization, provider/wildcard rejection, all-components no-follow descriptor acquisition, cancellation, and diagnostics. Its only results are Found(kind), Missing, and Rejected; only no-follow Missing becomes false without an error, while Rejected retains the catalog diagnostic and emits no Boolean.

variances.sourceFeature: TestPathType enum binding plus WriteObject(bool) scalar output
variances.targetDecision: Use an explicit case-insensitive static Any/Container/Leaf vocabulary and a finite BooleanRecord with explicit PipelineValueAdapter registration and prose scalar presentation. Enum abbreviations/numeric coercion, PSObject, ETS, type discovery, and table imitation are absent.

variances.sourceFeature: LiteralPath, provider drives, wildcard expansion, IsValid syntax mode, filters, dynamic parameters, provider ErrorRecords, links/hidden paths, and pipeline/property-name binding
variances.targetDecision: These source provider-engine behaviors are absent from the descriptor or fail closed at the shared binder/catalog boundary. The noninteractive runner also does not synthesize a mandatory Path prompt; omitted Path fails with AOT6211 and an unsupported closed PathType value fails with AOT6212.

variances.sourceFeature: ResolvePathCommand Path/LiteralPath/provider parameter declarations and parameter sets
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata remains authoritative; the executable descriptor is exactly GeneratedCmdletPorts.ResolvePath.CreateAotDescriptor("Path"). Only mandatory positional-or-named Path is admitted.

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord resolves provider/glob paths through SessionState.Path.GetResolvedPSPathFromPSPath and emits PathInfo
variances.targetDecision: Extend the existing IPhysicalChildItemCatalog with ResolveExistingDirectPhysicalPath. It shares strict captured-root lexical normalization and the sole metadata-free all-component no-follow acquisition primitive. Its closed outcome is Resolved(DirectPhysicalPathRecord), Missing, or Rejected; only Resolved emits one canonical Path record, while Missing/Rejected retain source-spanned nonterminating diagnostics and later values continue.

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState current location/provider normalization accepts dynamic path and drive semantics
variances.targetDecision: Rooted direct OS paths stay rooted and unrooted paths are lexical-normalized from the immutable catalog captured root, never invocation current directory. Empty direct input fails closed with AOT6213; whitespace remains a literal filename and normally reaches the catalog Missing/AOT6206 path. No drive/provider/current-location emulation is added.

variances.sourceFeature: PathInfo/PSObject output and dynamic format/type resolution
variances.targetDecision: Use only DirectPhysicalPathRecord(Path) registered explicitly in PipelineValueAdapter and ResolvePathPresentation.PathTable, an immutable one-column layout whose observed leading/final blank lines are layout-owned. No PathInfo, FileInfo, DirectoryInfo, PSObject, ETS, dynamic view, or global formatter rule enters the target.

variances.sourceFeature: LiteralPath/PSPath/LP, wildcard/provider expansion, Relative, RelativeBasePath, Force, provider transactions/ErrorRecords, and pipeline/property-name binding
variances.targetDecision: Those dynamic engine behaviors are absent from the generated descriptor or fail closed through the shared binder/catalog diagnostics. Omitted Path remains the noninteractive AOT6211 boundary; a future host/provider contract is required before widening.

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.Path.GetResolvedProviderPathFromPSPath provider conversion and string collection output
variances.targetDecision: Use generated Path-only binding and the existing IPhysicalChildItemCatalog.ResolveExistingDirectPhysicalPath closed outcome. Resolved projects only as existing TextRecord prose; no provider, PathInfo, PSObject, FileInfo, wildcarding, or second resolver is added.

variances.sourceFeature: Bound Path collection can contain arbitrary provider values
variances.targetDecision: Before any resolver call, inspect all values in source order. The first exact empty value emits the sole source-spanned AOT6213 and immediately returns with zero output, resolver calls, or other diagnostics. Whitespace remains literal only if the collection passes this gate.

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.Path.Combine and provider/dynamic parameter behavior
variances.targetDecision: Pure POSIX-v1 PathText composition; no filesystem, provider, current directory, drive, or resolver authority.

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell dynamic binding, path arrays, and remaining arguments
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata plus a descriptor-owned J1 group-preserving static binding mode; unsupported parameters fail closed.

variances.sourceFeature: Provider/session-state parse routes and dynamic parameter-set selection
variances.targetDecision: Pure POSIX-v1 Parent/Leaf/LeafBase/Extension/IsAbsolute selector table; conflicting selectors fail closed.

variances.sourceFeature: WriteObject string/bool through PowerShell objects and formatting
variances.targetDecision: Closed TextRecord/BooleanRecord output and existing static presentation.

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.Path resolves PowerShell provider paths, provider wildcards, and literal paths
variances.targetDecision: IPhysicalFileResolver accepts direct physical files; Path supports deterministic terminal-name * and ? expansion and LiteralPath remains literal

variances.sourceFeature: InputStream parameter set and ProcessRecord/EndProcessing stream hashing
variances.targetDecision: InputStream is absent from the AOT descriptor until a typed stream and generic pipeline binding service exists

variances.sourceFeature: FileHashInfo output with PowerShell ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: typed FileHashRecord projects Algorithm, Hash, and Path without PSObject or format-data dependencies

variances.sourceFeature: localized ErrorRecord construction for missing, unauthorized, and I/O file failures
variances.targetDecision: AotExecutionContext writes stable source-aligned IDs FileNotFound, UnauthorizedAccessError, and FileReadError with plain host messages

variances.sourceFeature: PSObject wrapping DateTime with ETS DisplayHint note property and PowerShell format data
variances.targetDecision: typed DateRecord carries DateTime plus Date/Time/DateTime display policy; the compact renderer uses round-trip value display

variances.sourceFeature: StringUtil composite formatting in fixed UFormat switch
variances.targetDecision: direct static BCL formatting and source-equivalent UFormat token mapping; FileDate aliases are explicit static mappings

variances.sourceFeature: Date ValueFromPipeline and ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName binding
variances.targetDecision: direct Date arguments are implemented; generic typed record/scalar pipeline binder is deferred and no input stage is silently accepted

variances.sourceFeature: empty or trailing-percent UFormat reaches source indexing failure
variances.targetDecision: stable ScriptException identifies the malformed format before evaluation

variances.sourceFeature: Time parameter set calls new TimeSpan(Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Milliseconds)
variances.targetDecision: generated opt-in descriptor binds only the five generated integer components and invokes the same static BCL constructor through AotCmdletBase lifecycle

variances.sourceFeature: TimeSpan CLR object output with PowerShell formatting and property adaptation
variances.targetDecision: TimeSpanRecord is a closed target record and PipelineValueAdapter maps only a synthetic invariant-c Value field, components, ticks, and total-duration fields; direct terminal output is invariant c format. The source TimeSpan has no Value property and shared table rendering may round displayed totals.

variances.sourceFeature: Date parameter set accepts Start/LastWriteTime/End, positional DateTime input, current-time defaults, ValueFromPipeline, and property-name binding
variances.targetDecision: all direct Date parameter-set members are absent from the executable descriptor and fail at generated binding; positional dates also fail there. Pipeline DateTime input fails earlier in the structural lowerer as AOT1001 until a reviewed typed DateTime input/conversion and parameter-set contract exists

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell scalar conversion and engine error records for component binding/constructor range failures
variances.targetDecision: invariant integer conversion is explicit; invalid or fractional scalar text is AOT3005 and combined TimeSpan overflow is AOT3006 with source spans and corrective guidance. PowerShell's broader numeric-to-int coercion is deferred rather than approximated

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord emits Guid.CreateVersion7 by default or Guid.Empty when Empty.ToBool() is true
variances.targetDecision: generated descriptor plus static Guid.CreateVersion7/Guid.Empty in AotCmdletBase lifecycle; direct output uses the existing closed TextRecord prose presentation

variances.sourceFeature: SwitchParameter accepts an attached Boolean value such as -Empty:$false
variances.targetDecision: the shared AST-derived binder preserves CommandParameterAst.Argument attachment and accepts only a direct Boolean literal; strings, null, variables, and other attached values fail closed

variances.sourceFeature: InputObject string parameter set, positional GUID parsing, ValueFromPipeline binding, WriteError(StringNotRecognizedAsGuid), and null output behavior
variances.targetDecision: InputObject is intentionally absent from the executable descriptor. Named input, positional input, and Empty plus InputObject fail at generated binding rather than introducing pseudo-string/null behavior or a generic Guid value layer

variances.sourceFeature: Guid object output and PowerShell type/formatting behavior
variances.targetDecision: the current runner writes one canonical D-format UUID line through existing TextRecord prose. A typed Guid pipeline value/record is deferred until it can be consumed without generic CLR-object adaptation

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord computes a selected parameter set then blocks through a private ManualResetEvent that StopProcessing signals
variances.targetDecision: generated -Milliseconds binds to a static StartSleepCmdlet which delegates exactly one integer-millisecond wait to the fixed IAotDelay substrate using the existing host-owned AotExecutionContext cancellation token

variances.sourceFeature: the source Milliseconds parameter is an int with ValidateRange(0, int.MaxValue) and PowerShell scalar coercion
variances.targetDecision: admit exactly one invariant whole-number value in 0..Int32.MaxValue; source-spanned AOT3007/AOT3008/AOT3009 distinguish missing admitted duration, invalid text, and range failure rather than approximating broader coercion

variances.sourceFeature: the Seconds default parameter set accepts positional/pipeline double input and Duration accepts positional/pipeline TimeSpan input with a maximum-duration terminating error
variances.targetDecision: Seconds, Duration/ts, positional input, and all pipeline input—including source Milliseconds ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName—are absent from the executable descriptor or structural pipeline contract and fail closed; no floating-point conversion, typed TimeSpan input, property-name binding, or generic pipeline binder is implied

variances.sourceFeature: the source cmdlet coordinates a shell stop thread and private wait handle
variances.targetDecision: the existing AotCmdletBase lifecycle observes host cancellation and ScriptRunner maps cancellation to exit 130; the port does not claim Ctrl+C signal wiring, a cmdlet-owned cancellation source, callbacks, timers, or a scheduling API

variances.sourceFeature: HelpSystem dynamically composes Alias, ScriptCommand, Command, Provider, Class, HelpFile, and DefaultHelp providers using session/module state
variances.targetDecision: Generate an immutable full-source HelpCatalog for every discovered cmdlet; it is independent from the smaller executable AOT command registry

variances.sourceFeature: MAML/HelpInfo topics, source command metadata, and runtime command discovery
variances.targetDecision: Every catalogued source cmdlet receives generated contract help and explicit AOT status, including commands without an AOT adapter

variances.sourceFeature: Module-path discovery imports/loads module code and delegates help to the runtime HelpSystem
variances.targetDecision: Scan declarative extensions/<module>/<version>/extension.json at query time with Native-AOT JSON source generation; metadata/help discovery never requires command registry membership or module assembly loading. help.json is an optional authored overlay rather than a discovery prerequisite.

variances.sourceFeature: runtime help-file/MAML lookup and updatable help content
variances.targetDecision: Optional extension help.json overlays manifest contracts. Missing, unreadable, malformed, or identity-invalid authored help falls back visibly to generated extension.json contract help; a malformed manifest or invalid provenance identity still rejects the package.

variances.sourceFeature: runtime culture-specific help-file discovery
variances.targetDecision: Generate selected cultures with exact-to-parent-to-en-US-to-contract fallback; begin with en-US rather than claim all installed PowerShell help cultures

variances.sourceFeature: -Online launches a browser and -ShowWindow uses the graphical host
variances.targetDecision: Core AOT help presents validated HTTP(S) HelpUri; browser/window behavior requires an explicit host policy and is not part of the headless core

variances.sourceFeature: provider, script, alias, class, DSC, external-script, and current-session help categories
variances.targetDecision: Initial scope supports generated Cmdlet category only; dynamic/provider/session categories are deferred behind a future explicit extension model

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.InvokeCommand discovers live CommandInfo objects from imported modules, aliases, applications, functions, scripts, providers, and current-session state
variances.targetDecision: CompositeHelpCatalog merges the build-generated 290-cmdlet source catalog with declarative extension JSON; discovery never loads an extension module or consults only the executable adapter registry

variances.sourceFeature: Name, Module/PSSnapin, and CommandType query modes
variances.targetDecision: Support positional/-Name with case-insensitive SimpleWildcard, -Module including PSSnapin alias, and Cmdlet/Function CommandType filtering over typed CommandInfoRecord data

variances.sourceFeature: AliasInfo, ApplicationInfo, FunctionInfo, CmdletInfo, ExternalScriptInfo, FilterInfo, and PSObject outputs formatted by ETS
variances.targetDecision: Typed CommandInfoRecord exposes Name, CommandType, ModuleName, Version, Source, Availability, Status, and generated Syntax without PSObject or formatting data; Availability is a default column so discovery is not mistaken for executability

variances.sourceFeature: All, ArgumentList, ExcludeModule, FullyQualifiedModule, ListImported, Noun, ParameterName, ParameterType, ShowCommandInfo, Syntax, TotalCount, abbreviation/fuzzy matching, Verb, and non-Cmdlet/Function types
variances.targetDecision: Reject unsupported options/types at parse time; defer them until an explicit session and extension execution model exists

variances.sourceFeature: live ModuleInfo assembly/module identity
variances.targetDecision: Generated built-in contracts report PowerShell.BuiltIn; preserving original per-assembly module identity requires a source-generator path/assembly mapping input

variances.sourceFeature: PSModuleInfo, current-session loaded-module state, and $PSModulePath discovery
variances.targetDecision: CompositeModuleCatalog reports one logical generated PowerShell.BuiltIn module plus declarative extension.json packages, without importing a module, loading an assembly, or invoking a command

variances.sourceFeature: Name query over loaded, available, remote, CIM, and fully qualified module modes
variances.targetDecision: Support only positional/-Name using the shared case-insensitive * and ? matcher; reject All, ListAvailable, Refresh, FullyQualifiedName, PSSession, CimSession, PSEdition, and SkipEditionCheck until their safe source of truth exists

variances.sourceFeature: live PSModuleInfo objects with module implementation details and ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: Typed ModuleInfoRecord exposes Name, Version, Origin, Availability, Status, Path, Trust, and Provenance sourced only from generated contracts and declarative package metadata

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShellGet/repository policy is separate from Get-Module and legacy import can execute arbitrary module initialization
variances.targetDecision: Show provenance but label every external package trust state unverified until a signed repository, hash, dependency, and install policy is designed; Get-Module itself never imports modules

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell module discovery has version selection, manifest identity, and error behavior tied to module paths and loaded session state
variances.targetDecision: One data-only ExtensionPackageCatalog validates extension schema v1, duplicate names, manifest/help/provenance identity correlation, and selects the highest dotted version (then lexical/path tie-breakers) for Get-Help/Get-Command while Get-Module inventories every valid installed version

ports.source: PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet package discovery; explicit PwshAotLite host control-plane contract rather than a generated src cmdlet

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell repository search is coupled to PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet repository protocol and package-management state
variances.targetDecision: Separate IRepositoryCatalog/RepositoryCatalog reads versioned declarative local repository-index JSON and projects typed advertised module data without joining installed extension discovery

variances.sourceFeature: Find-Module can query configured remote repositories and participates in a package-management workflow
variances.targetDecision: Find-Module itself has no HTTP client, credential lookup, package download, install, module import, DLL load, or script execution; a separate Install-Module local-file proof may consume a declared file URI only after explicit staging policy

variances.sourceFeature: Repository identity, package hashes/signatures, dependency resolution, prerelease policy, paging, and PSGallery/PSResourceGet protocol semantics
variances.targetDecision: Defer live repository transport and package-manager installation until an opt-in staged trust policy validates repository identity, signatures, dependencies, activation, and credentials outside read-only discovery; current local-file activation is intentionally narrower

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell package manager handles remote response parsing and repository policy
variances.targetDecision: Bound local index reads to 1 MiB/16 JSON levels and reject invalid schema, duplicate identities, controls, unsafe URI schemes/user-info, and unknown registration modes before materializing typed entries

variances.sourceFeature: JsonObject uses Newtonsoft plus PowerShell PSObject/hashtable materialization and ConvertFrom-Json writes dynamically enumerated results.
variances.targetDecision: One pure System.Text.Json codec now parses only into immutable closed AotValue/AotRecord cases and has managed/native self-test evidence; no executable ConvertFrom-Json adapter is registered.

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord buffers pipeline strings and EndProcessing chooses separate-document versus newline-joined JSON behavior; DateKind, AsHashtable, Depth, and NoEnumerate alter source semantics.
variances.targetDecision: Do not admit source parameters or pipeline aggregation without a static generated-metadata binding and typed-output design; all are deferred during J0.

variances.sourceFeature: The default ConvertFrom-Json PSObject route rejects JSON keys differing only by case, while -AsHashtable has a distinct hashtable route.
variances.targetDecision: The initial closed AotRecord route rejects exact duplicates, case collisions, and blank/whitespace property names with AOT6304. Stock default ConvertFrom-Json accepts an exact duplicate with the latter value, so that rejection is an explicit fail-closed variance. -AsHashtable is wholly deferred; no hashtable behavior is implied.

variances.sourceFeature: Stock default ConvertFrom-Json accepts a JSON object property whose name consists only of whitespace.
variances.targetDecision: The closed AotRecord route rejects a whitespace-only property name with AOT6304. This is a deliberate fail-closed validation variance because the immutable record field contract disallows unsafe names; it does not claim stock validation parity.

variances.sourceFeature: ConvertTo-Json accepts arbitrary object input and PowerShell/Json.NET preprocessing before serializing it.
variances.targetDecision: The implemented J0 codec accepts only existing closed AotValue cases. It never discovers CLR members, reflects, wraps PSObject, or invokes a generic serializer; no ConvertTo-Json adapter is registered.

variances.sourceFeature: AsArray, Compress, Depth, EnumsAsStrings, EscapeHandling, and cmdlet-owned cancellation shape source output and lifecycle.
variances.targetDecision: No option is admitted until a generated descriptor opt-in and stock/native formatting oracle establish a bounded contract. The shared codec is implemented but no command adapter exists.

variances.sourceFeature: WhereObjectCommand Property/Value/operator aliases and parameter sets are owned by PSCmdlet metadata.
variances.targetDecision: GeneratedCmdletPorts.WhereObject supplies the reviewed Property, Value, EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, and LE parameter metadata; aliases are matched from generated metadata and are not manually copied.

variances.sourceFeature: Where-Object performs PSObject member access, ScriptBlock execution, and PowerShell conversion over source input.
variances.targetDecision: The reviewed route consumes only AotRecordBatch rows and applies one finite numeric comparison to an explicitly named record field. It adds no object binder, reflection, provider, or dynamic engine.

variances.sourceFeature: ProcessRecord writes the original source input object for matching rows.
variances.targetDecision: Matching immutable AotRecord rows preserve input order and fields; PSObject/ETS identity is unavailable by design.

variances.sourceFeature: FilterScript, direct InputObject, pattern/type/collection/case-sensitive operators, and dynamic property semantics.
variances.targetDecision: All unreviewed routes terminate at AOT6406 before execution; no fallback uses the prior structural path.

variances.sourceFeature: SelectObjectCommand Property position and parameter-set metadata are owned by PSCmdlet metadata.
variances.targetDecision: GeneratedCmdletPorts.SelectObject supplies the reviewed Property metadata; the AST retains the property group without a text parser or second binder.

variances.sourceFeature: SelectObjectCommand binds one positional Property group or one named -Property group; mixed positional/named values are rejected by the source binder.
variances.targetDecision: AST-preserved groups enforce the same closed binding boundary: exactly one positional group or one generated -Property group. Mixed or repeated bare groups fail source-spanned AOT6404; there is no secondary or legacy route.

variances.sourceFeature: Select-Object uses PSPropertyExpression, PSObject wrapping, note-property mutation, and output lifecycle queues.
variances.targetDecision: The reviewed route projects only literal AotRecord fields through the existing immutable AotRecordShape/AotRecordBatch substrate.

variances.sourceFeature: Selected-object type names and ETS/type-data determine ordinary PowerShell display behavior.
variances.targetDecision: Requested field spelling/order is the exact closed output shape and table; no Selected.* type name or dynamic formatter is claimed.

variances.sourceFeature: InputObject, calculated/wildcard properties, exclusion/expansion, unique/index/queue/first/last/skip/wait options.
variances.targetDecision: All unreviewed routes reject with AOT6404 or AOT6406 before execution; no fallback uses the prior structural path.

ports.source: PowerShell completion, ArgumentCompleter, and Register-ArgumentCompleter subsystems

variances.sourceFeature: Tab completion resolves live SessionState commands, modules, parameters, aliases, help, providers, and extensibility hooks
variances.targetDecision: CompletionService projects CompositeHelpCatalog and CompositeModuleCatalog through explicit --complete and REPL complete endpoints; command/help suggestions visibly retain catalog availability

variances.sourceFeature: ValidateSet completion evaluates source cmdlet metadata and may use custom validation generators
variances.targetDecision: HelpParameter carries generated or manifest validation metadata; only direct literal ValidateSet values are suggested and source expressions/constants are never evaluated

variances.sourceFeature: ArgumentCompleter attributes, Register-ArgumentCompleter, script blocks, and module-defined completion can execute arbitrary code during discovery
variances.targetDecision: Do not import modules, load extension assemblies, invoke completers, or run script during completion; dynamic completion is deferred pending an explicit extension trust/execution policy

variances.sourceFeature: Provider/filesystem/value completion and PSReadLine terminal TAB integration
variances.targetDecision: Path/provider/value completion and terminal key handling are deferred; CompletionInput only lexes an incomplete line while UpstreamAstPipelineLowerer remains executable syntax authority

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell module/session command precedence and command resolution can choose an active command from a live runspace
variances.targetDecision: Get-Module retains all package versions, while module completion uses the same deterministic active package winner as help/command lookup; same-name active command contracts are never silently resolved: Get-Help/Get-Command retain every candidate and completion reports ambiguity without parameter completion

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell completion objects remain structured inside the host rather than a line-oriented external protocol
variances.targetDecision: The explicit completion endpoint uses TSV and escapes backslashes, tabs, line breaks, and other control characters from extension metadata before writing output

ports.source: PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet package installation; explicit PwshAotLite host control-plane contract rather than a generated src cmdlet

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell package tooling integrates repository selection, transport, package extraction, dependency handling, module paths, and installation state
variances.targetDecision: Separate IModuleInstaller consumes IRepositoryCatalog records and is the sole current write boundary; Find-Module and all discovery catalogs stay read-only

variances.sourceFeature: Install-Module supports remote repositories and package-manager transports
variances.targetDecision: Accept only hostless credential-free file URIs whose directory is physically contained by explicit PWSH_AOT_PACKAGE_ROOTS, physically canonicalize configured roots so platform aliases remain valid, require an explicit PWSH_AOT_EXTENSIONS_ROOT write target, and reject symlinks below resolved trusted roots. These two deployment keys flow through injectable IAotHostConfiguration rather than direct cmdlet environment access.

variances.sourceFeature: Package tooling owns archive/package integrity and installation transactions
variances.targetDecision: Bound a local directory package by file count/size/path/link/regular-file policy, compare a declared SHA-256, stage in a fixed hidden same-volume directory that ExtensionPackageCatalog globally excludes from every configured recursive discovery root, rehash source and staged copies with fixed-time comparisons, verify the activation volume, validate staged manifest/help/provenance through ExtensionPackageCatalog, then atomically rename into activation; unequal existing content is a conflict and equal content is idempotent

variances.sourceFeature: Repository signatures, certificate/trust policy, credentials, dependencies, version ranges, uninstall/rollback, PSGallery/PSResourceGet transport, and legacy module execution
variances.targetDecision: Defer all remote transport and trust/package-manager semantics. Installation never imports a module, loads an assembly, runs script, or makes a registered legacy command executable
